scripts.dev: mkdir -p .emulator-data && pnpm --filter ./web build && pnpm --filter ./functions build && (pnpm --filter ./web build:watch & pnpm --filter ./functions build:watch & npx firebase-tools emulators:start --only hosting,functions,firestore,storage --import=.emulator-data --export-on-exit=.emulator-data)
scripts.dev:emulators: mkdir -p .emulator-data && (pnpm --filter ./web build:watch & pnpm --filter ./functions build:watch & npx firebase-tools emulators:start --only hosting,functions,firestore,storage --import=.emulator-data --export-on-exit=.emulator-data)
